title: llm-rosetta shim source manifest
description: The manifest.json a shim source repository publishes on its dist branch (#1660). One record per released vendor version; a gateway installs the newest record whose 'requires' its core satisfies. Unknown keys are allowed so a producer can add a field without a new manifest_version; a removed field or a changed meaning raises manifest_version. A consumer reads the document record by record: an invalid top level (not an object, an unknown manifest_version, a missing required key, 'vendors' not an object) fails the whole source, while an invalid vendor entry or release record is skipped with a warning naming the vendor, the version and the reason, and the rest of the manifest is used.

manifest_version.description: The manifest format level. A consumer refuses a level it does not know.

source.description: Short source id; also the catalogue key and the '<source>:' prefix in shims.install. 'tag' is reserved (shims.install reads 'tag:' as a tag).

repo.description: The repository that publishes this manifest.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 time the manifest was generated.

vendors.description: One entry per vendor directory, keyed by the directory name.

versions.description: Every released version. A published entry is never edited. Producers list newest first; consumers order by semantic version, not by position.

version.description: Per-vendor version: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release (-rc.1), no build metadata (+build is refused). A consumer installs the newest installable stable version; a pre-release only when no stable version is installable.

commit.description: The source commit the wheel was built from.

archive.description: Wheel path relative to the directory that holds manifest.json (the dist branch root). The wheel is a pure-Python extension wheel: one llm_rosetta_ext/<vendor>/ folder with its plugin.yaml.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex digest of the wheel bytes.

shims.description: The shim names the wheel registers. Each is the vendor key itself (a bare shim such as 'xai'), '<vendor>--<name>', or '<vendor>_<lane>--<name>' (a lane of the vendor, such as 'alcf_sophia--chat_completions'); the validator refuses a name that carries another vendor's prefix, including a lane prefix that is itself a vendor key of the same manifest.

tags.description: Free-form selection tags: tier:free|paid|subscription, auth:oauth, region:cn, ...

maturity.description: The vendor's stage on the maturity ladder.

since.description: The date the current maturity was reached.

promoted_to.description: Set when the vendor moved into core, e.g. 'core@0.15.0'. A consumer reads it from the record it would install (the newest installable), so a later release without it un-promotes the vendor; the claim is honoured only when the running core is at or above that version (a dev or pre-release of it is before it) and core registers the record's shims.

label.description: Optional display name of the vendor (its provider.yaml group_label), e.g. 'Kilo (Free)'. Per record, so a release can change it; a consumer reads it from the record it would install. A consumer that finds an invalid value drops this field only, with a warning, never the record.

logo.description: Optional https URL of the vendor's mark (its provider.yaml logo), so a vendor that is not installed is still drawn with it. Per record; a consumer that finds an invalid value drops this field only, with a warning, never the record.

requires.description: Compatibility: 'surface' must equal the core's contracts.SURFACE_VERSION, and 'ir' must not exceed its contracts.IR_VERSION.

conformance.description: The last tools/conformance result for this version.
